Before I Ask You Something…

I still remember how nervous I was when I came to meet you for the first time. But the moment we started talking, something quietly changed — and somewhere in that first conversation, I found myself thinking, “Maybe I could spend my forever with her.” ❤️

Then I started looking for little ways to talk to you more… and thankfully, Instagram came to my rescue. 😊

A few messages slowly became endless conversations — about everything, about nothing, and everything in between. And without even realizing it, our conversations started turning into something beautiful.

We never had enough time together, yet somehow, those little moments became memories worth keeping forever.

I would plan a hundred things before meeting you, but the moment I was with you, time somehow forgot to slow down. It always ended with me wishing for just a little more.

And now, whenever my phone lights up with a notification, a little part of me still hopes it’s you. ❤️

And how beautiful is it… when the person you’re going to marry is also the person who has been your biggest crush?

I could write about us forever… but there’s one thing I’ve been waiting to ask you.

So this time, I want to ask you properly… ❤️

Shall We Make This More Beautiful? 🌊

Because the best love stories are written with patience, laughter, and forever.

A moment I'd choose with you, forever. 💍❤️

Some stories are written in moments. Ours, I think, was written in all the little things that slowly led my heart to you. ❤️

And if I could choose one place, one moment, and one person to walk into every tomorrow with… it would always be you.

So, my love, let me ask you the simplest question with the biggest piece of my heart:

Will you stay with me through every season of life — and make every tomorrow ours? 💍

My heart is still waiting for the answer that makes life brighter.
Congratulations, my love — you just made my whole world glow. 💖
CONGRATULATIONS TO US! ❤️
